cyclicEdgeBaselineMigration.algorithm: All directed edges within strongly connected components
cyclicEdgeBaselineMigration.note: The old and corrected scanners returned identical modules and dependency edges. This migration records existing edges the DFS witness list missed; it does not accept newly added imports. Other baseline fields were preserved.

project-templates.why: Fixed source projects executed only inside E2B; cannot import WhyBuddy host code.

shared.why: 叶子：前后端同读的契约。**不许依赖任何其它包**——对应 grok 的叶子 crate，也是「同一份契约两份实现」这类事故的唯一解药。

client.why: 浏览器包。不许依赖 server（Node-only 代码进不了浏览器包，Vite 不一定当场报错）。

server.why: Node 包。⚠ `server -> client` 只有一条边，是**有意的**：server/sliderule/session-driver 复用 client/src/lib/sliderule-runtime 的多步重入循环，而不是抄第二份。那个文件的模块头写着 there is NO second copy of the loop here。这仓踩过三次「两份实现各自漂移」的坑，所以这条例外是对的——但它必须**被声明**，而不是恰好没人看。

scripts.why: Build, development and acceptance CLI processes. They exercise product modules but product packages must not depend on scripts.

project-template-vite.why: Versioned React/TS/Vite template. index.html loads src/main.tsx after Python publishes these files to E2B.

project-template-tasks.why: Fixed runnable task application: Node API and SQLite data, Vite development and production static output. Python publishes sources to E2B; application identities and data belong to this project.

client-pages-sliderule.why: 推演产品的主页面族：会话舞台、画布、区块运行时、点选编辑。前端最大的一块。

client-pages-autopilot.why: Autopilot 路线页与右栏控制面。产品面收敛的对象（见 M17），改动前先确认它还在不在主路径上。

client-pages.why: 其余页面：agent-loop / specs / admin / tasks / nl-command / 落地页。

client-components.why: 可复用组件：ui 原语、任务、three/UE 叠加、回放、血缘、nl-command。

client-lib.why: 前端库层：推演运行时、项目存储、路由规划、浏览器侧 LLM。workers 是叶子（被 serializer 用），不进装配根。

client-runtime.why: 生成件在浏览器里跑起来的运行时（bind / DOMPurify 白名单那条线）。

client-shell.why: 前端装配根与横切件：入口、全局上下文、hooks、i18n、开发夹具。worker 下沉到 client-lib。

server-routes-blueprint.why: 蓝图 HTTP 面，211 个模块——server 里最大的一块，多数是 takeover / closure 类的切片。

server-routes.why: 其余 HTTP 路由与 node-adapters。

server-core.why: 服务端核心：socket、注册表、治理、a2a 适配、nl-command。auth/runtime/config/startup 从组合根拆过来——grok 的 pager-bin 也不把库放进 binary crate。

server-sliderule.why: 推演在 Node 侧的适配层：确定性 provider、代理启动诊断、session-driver（复用前端运行时的循环，见下方 layer 的例外声明）。

server-permission.why: 权限：范围批准与发布批准（M12）。

server-audit.why: 审计 / 血缘 / 回放：证据类，fail-closed。

server-tasks.why: 任务调度、场景指令、工具面。

server-integrations.why: 外部集成：飞书、知识库、web-aigc 提供方。增强类，fail-open。

server-entry.why: 服务端装配根（对应 grok 的 xai-grok-pager-bin）：只负责把东西装起来。**被依赖数必须是 0**。auth/runtime/config 是库，不进这个 crate。

shared-blueprint.why: 蓝图与五系统推演状态的共享契约。前后端同读一份，是这仓最要紧的契约面。

shared-web-aigc.why: web-aigc 各能力的契约。一能力一文件，与 Python 侧 services/web_aigc_*_adapter 成对——⚠ 改一边不改另一边会静默失效（CLAUDE.md 第四条）。

shared-workflow.why: 工作流内核与运行时契约。

shared-contracts.why: 其余共享契约：a2a、auth、cost、env、mission、permission、rag、replay、技能、UE、组织。**叶子性质**：被 client 与 server 同时依赖，不许反向依赖任何一边。

agent-loop-src.why: 薄控制面 Agent Loop 的实现（M1）。

agent-loop-vscode.why: Agent Loop 的 VS Code 扩展。

agent-loop-tools.why: Agent Loop 的脚本与夹具。

lobster-executor.why: 沙箱执行器，独立进程（:3031），只依赖 shared 的契约。

server-project-verification.why: Trusted fixed-suite browser CLI uploaded by the Python provider to an independent E2B sandbox. Public Playwright calls collect actual evidence; SQL authority and delivery decisions remain in Python.

server-project-preview.why: Dedicated private-preview HTTP/WebSocket transport; Python owns access. The shared self-contained selection bridge only sends source locations, and the gateway binds it to current authorized runtime identity.

ops-scripts.why: Executable build/dev/architecture/smoke programs and their shared helpers. Exact CLI entrypoints are declared; imported helpers remain ordinary dependencies.

project-preview-fixtures.why: Cloud acceptance fixture launches the production preview relay against a controlled test authority. This is a smoke entrypoint, not a product authentication service.

reasons.project-templates/react-vite-tasks/serve: Template package.json dev/start scripts launch the Node API in the E2B runtime; Python owns that process lifecycle.
reasons.project-templates/react-vite-tasks/src/m: Template index.html mounts this React entry in both Vite development and built output.
reasons.shared/project-preview-selection.d: TypeScript resolves the .d.mts declaration alongside the runtime .mjs import; it has no runtime execution or import edge.
reasons.server/project-verification/browser-runn: services.project_browser_provider uploads this CLI to an independent trusted sandbox and executes Node; cross-language invocation is exercised by provider and product browser smoke tests.
reasons.scripts/project-product-browser-smoke: Python scripts/project-product-smoke.py launches this real-browser CLI; the cross-language call is outside TypeScript imports.
reasons.scripts/project-tasks-browser-smoke: Python scripts/project-product-smoke.py --tasks launches the actual shared workbench, API, E2B and browser acceptance scenario.
reasons.scripts/project-preview-csp: Root vite.config.ts imports this build configuration provider; root config files are outside scanned package directories. project-preview-csp.test.mjs exercises the actual Vite serve transform and production HTML build so removing that call fails.
